entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Certainly, I can help with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Of course. The name is Sarah Chen, order number VF-881-92B.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your order here, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a defect. The pulse readings are all over the place. I was on a hard climb yesterday and it said my heart rate was 60. The thing is garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear that the readings are inaccurate. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'd be happy to walk you through a few quick troubleshooting steps. Sometimes a sensor recalibration can resolve that.
I appreciate the offer, but I don't have time for that. I've already decided I'd prefer to just get my money back. I just want a refund.
I understand. Our policy for a defective item typically requires us to verify the fault before processing a return outside the initial 10-day window. Without that, it's handled as a standard return.
Look, I'm not trying to pull a fast one. I'm not one of those people who just want money back after using something. The product simply doesn't work. What does your standard return policy say?
Of course, I understand. Let me just pull up the official policy details for you. Please hold one moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting, Sarah. I've just checked our internal knowledge base. It states here that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since your order was delivered 35 days ago, you are unfortunately outside that timeframe.
Oh, that's straightforward enough. So we can proceed with the return then?

Absolutely. Since you're within the 10-day window, I can approve this right away. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. As you're a VIP customer, and as an apology for the faulty device, I've also added a 20% discount code to your account for any future purchase.
That's very helpful. Thank you for making that easy, Alex.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the band at our warehouse, the full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
